page_title: EVE 1-3 SUN | Everton v Sunderland 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' James Garner (Everton) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
90+4' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
90+1' 1 - 3 Goal! Habib Diarra tees up Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 1:3.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
88' David Moyes prepares a substitution. Jake O'Brien is replaced by Seamus Coleman (Everton).
88' That's the end of the game for Merlin Rohl, who is replaced by Dwight McNeil (Everton).
86' Everton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

86' What a save from Robin Roefs! Jake O'Brien (Everton) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out. Everton will take a corner kick.
84' Merlin Rohl (Everton) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
81' 1 - 2 Goal! Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) takes a short pass from Christopher Rigg in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
77' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Noah Sadiki and he is replaced by Habib Diarra (Sunderland).
77' Brian Brobbey will be replaced by Wilson Isidor (Sunderland).
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Christopher Rigg (Sunderland) for Nilson Angulo.
75' Everton are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
73' The referee signals a substitution. Thierno Barry (Everton) is brought on as a substitute for Beto.
73' Here is a change. Tim Iroegbunam is going off and David Moyes gives the last tactical orders to Tyrique George (Everton).

72' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Everton are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
69' Total attempts – 7:5.
67' James Garner (Everton) is penalised for holding. John Brooks signals a set piece.
64' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
63' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
60' A substitution has been made. Trai Hume is replaced by Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland).
59' 1 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) was set free in the area by Enzo Le Fee and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
57' The resulting set piece from Sunderland is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

56' Trai Hume (Sunderland) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Sunderland have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Sunderland failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
54' The free kick from close range, taken by Sunderland, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
53' James Garner (Everton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Sunderland are awarded the free kick.
52' Jake O'Brien (Everton) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
49' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
48' Sunderland couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Jordan Pickford (Everton) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
47' Jake O'Brien (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make. Sunderland have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
46' The whistle blows and John Brooks starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' 1 - 0 Goal! Michael Keane passes the ball to Merlin Rohl (Everton) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Robin Roefs couldn't do anything about it. 1:0.
41' Beto (Everton) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
37' Everton quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
37' A header by James Tarkowski (Everton) from very close range goes towards the left-hand post, but doesn't get past Robin Roefs, who makes a brilliant save. Everton have a corner.
35' James Garner (Everton) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
34' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) threads a pass through to Nilson Angulo, but Jordan Pickford breaks up the move.

32' Everton slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
29' The foul by Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) was seen by John Brooks who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
27' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.

25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. The referee signals a free kick. Sunderland are going to take it from long range.
23' Regis Le Bris is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Omar Alderete (Sunderland) suffers an injury and Luke O'Nien comes on.
21' Looks like Omar Alderete (Sunderland) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
20' Beto (Everton) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball is out of play. Everton will have a throw-in.
18' The Everton players are exchanging some short passes.
14' Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
14' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman signals a throw-in for Sunderland.
12' Sunderland hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
9' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Robin Roefs (Sunderland).
8' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) commits a foul and John Brooks immediately signals a free kick.
6' Everton couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Robin Roefs (Sunderland) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
6' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Everton earn a free kick.
4' Beto (Everton) meets a cross inside the box, but Robin Roefs wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
3' Neat passing move from Sunderland in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Everton will have the kick-off.
John Brooks will referee today's match.
